title: A Hybrid Genetic Algorithm for Nurse Scheduling Problem considering the Fatigue Factor.
problem: The urgent need to modify nurse scheduling to address the fatigue of nurses caring for COVID-19 patients 24 hours a day.
contribution: Proposes a new mathematical model for Nurse Scheduling Problem (NSP) considering the fatigue factor and develops a hybrid Genetic Algorithm (GA) to solve it.
method: Developed a hybrid Genetic Algorithm (GA) to provide a nurse schedule for all three shifts of a day.
data_setup: A randomly generated problem and a real case study at a hospital in Esfahan, Iran.
results: The proposed model provided a nurse schedule for May, which was superior to the manual schedule currently used in the department.
